$description: Source of truth. Collections: primitives, theme (Light/Dark), radius, spacing, typography. Theme tokens carry Light in $value and Dark in $extensions["com.satin"].modes.Dark.

primitives.$description: Raw palettes. Hidden from publishing and from every picker; components use theme only.

card-dark.$description: Dark surface step 2 of 4 (OKLCH L 0.183): content wrapper.

surface-dark.$description: Dark surface step 3 of 4 (OKLCH L 0.218): inputs.

popover-dark.$description: Dark surface step 4 of 4 (OKLCH L 0.252): buttons, menus, dialogs.

secondary-hover-dark.$description: white-a8 on card (zinc-900), opaque. Secondary button hover in Dark.

secondary-pressed-dark.$description: white-a12 on card (zinc-900), opaque. Secondary button pressed in Dark.

primary-dark.$description: Primary in Dark: blue-600 (#4633D7) hue at OKLCH L 0.48 — barely lifted, the anchor already reads on the dark surfaces.

primary-focus-dark.$description: Focus colour in Dark: primary, light enough to read at 3:1 on every Dark surface (bg/selected is the lightest).

transparent.$description: Added: alias target for highlight-top in Light.

blue-600-a20.$description: No longer the focus ring (it is solid since 0.7); kept for themes that read it.

text-muted-light.$description: Muted text in Light: a touch darker than zinc-500 so it reads at 4.5:1 on bg/muted too.

selected-light.$description: bg/selected in Light: between zinc-100 (hover) and zinc-200, so a current item reads lighter.

selected-dark.$description: bg/selected in Dark: a touch darker than the pressed secondary, still above hover.

segmented-selected-dark.$description: The picked segment in Dark: lighter than any track it sits on (bg/muted, popover tracks), so it reads.

bg.$description: Backgrounds and surfaces. Dark ramp: canvas < card < field < popover.

canvas.$description: Dark surface step 1 of 4: the whole view, sidebar.

card.$description: Dark surface step 2 of 4: content wrapper next to the navigation, cards.

field.$description: Input fields (input, select trigger, checkbox, radio, prompt bar). Dark surface step 3 of 4, between card and popover.

popover.$description: Dark surface step 4 of 4: buttons, dropdowns, dialogs, banners.

selected.$description: Hovered and active (selected) row in dropdowns and menus: #EDEDEF / #2F2F32, a step above popover in both modes. As the only highlight it reads about 1.2:1, so keyboard-reached rows also take the focus ring.

pressed.$description: The neutral fill of something being pressed, open or on: a pressed Button or Chip, an open menu trigger, the active Sidebar row, an off Switch track, a disabled checked control. It was border/input's value doing a fill's job.

card-fade.$description: card at 0%: the clear end of fades over card (table overflow edge).

subtle.$description: Tertiary text: timestamps, counters, hints, placeholder-level meta. Below AA in Light (2.5:1 on white), so never for essential text.

placeholder.$description: Faint placeholder-level text, below AA (1.5:1 in Light): not for anything a user must read. Field placeholders use text/muted.

destructive.$description: Error text: field and form errors, error toasts. red-700 / red-400, at least 4.5:1 on every surface (the destructive fill, red-600, reads only 3.3:1 as text in Dark).

focus.$description: Focus colour: the field border on focus and the focus ring. At least 3:1 on every surface in both modes (blue/600 in Light, primary-focus-dark in Dark).

action.$description: Interactive controls: bg, bg-hover, bg-pressed, border, glow, shadow per variant.

fg.$description: Text and marks on the brand fill: white, or dark when a light brand would fall under 4.5:1 (set by the theme).

border.$description: 1px inside top-light border on primary buttons.

bg-hover.$description: Secondary button hover: zinc-100 / white-a8 on card. Lighter than default in Dark.

bg-pressed.$description: Secondary button pressed: zinc-200 / white-a12 on card. Lighter again in Dark, the border stays visible.

bg-hover.$description: Destructive button hover: a step darker than rest, so white on it stays above 4.5:1 (a lighter red would not).

bg-pressed.$description: Destructive button pressed: darker than hover.

border.$description: Inner stroke of the Destructive button: a lighter tint of its bg.

glow.$description: Inner glow of the Destructive button.

fg.$description: Text and icon of a destructive menu row (Delete): status/red/fg in light, a stronger red-400 in dark.

border.$description: Inner stroke of the Inverse button: clearly lighter than the dark bg in Light (like the primary border), a subtle zinc edge on the white Dark-mode button.

glow.$description: Inner glow of the Inverse button: white-a24 in both modes.

bg.$description: Inverse button: dark in Light, light in Dark.

focus-ring.$description: Focus ring: solid, the same colour as border/focus, at least 3:1 on every surface (WCAG 1.4.11). Drawn 2px wide: an outline 2px off the control for buttons and toggles, a ring around fields.

status.$description: Tone palette for chips, badges, toasts and avatars: bg, border, fg per tone.

effect.$description: Shadow and highlight colours used by the effect styles.

highlight-top.$description: 1px inset top light on floating surfaces in Dark.

component.$description: Values that only make sense for one component.

zebra.$description: Zebra rows: zinc-50 / surface-dark, one step off card. Fills every second row.

header.$description: Table header: zinc-50 in Light (same as zebra); card-dark in Dark, so it matches the rows.

selected.$description: Selected segment: white card (bg/card) in Light, a lighter grey than the track in Dark, with Shadow/sm under it.

pressed.$description: Pressed unselected segment: a faint wash over the track.

center.$description: Thinking rail line, middle stop of the vertical gradient (border-subtle / white-a10).

edge.$description: Thinking rail line, top and bottom stops: the middle colour at 25%.

hover-from.$description: Getting started item hover/pressed gradient, start stop.

hover-to.$description: Getting started item hover/pressed gradient, end stop.

on.$description: Switch track when on: calm green from the status palette, a step lighter in Dark.

on-hover.$description: Switch track when on and hovered: one step lighter, like the primary button hover.

bg.$description: Keycap fill: bg/card in Light, bg/muted in Dark, so a key reads on a popover in both.

badge-bg.$description: Neutral badge fill on a notification: status/neutral in Light, one step lighter in Dark, where status/neutral sits on the popover fill with almost no contrast.

selected-bg.$description: Fill of a selected Decision card chip: status/brand in Light; in Dark a 20% brand tint, more saturated than status/brand's grey-blue.

selected-border.$description: Edge of a selected Decision card chip: status/brand fg in Light; in Dark the brand's focus colour, a full brand hue where status/brand fg is a pale tint.

selected-fg.$description: Label of a selected Decision card chip: status/brand fg in Light; text/default in Dark, where the edge and the fill carry the brand.

bg.$description: The tile behind a file's type icon (Attachment, File upload items): bg/muted in Light; in Dark a lighter grey, since bg/muted sits too close to bg/popover there to read as a tile.

success-border.$description: Edge of Input OTP's cells once the code is verified: status/green fg in Light; in Dark the Switch's calm mid green, since status/green fg is a pale tint meant for text and reads loud as an edge.

bubble-bg.$description: The user's message bubble: action/inverse/bg in Light; in Dark a dark grey a step above the conversation (bg/muted), as chat apps draw it, with light text (bubble-fg).

bubble-fg.$description: Text in the user's message bubble: text/on-inverse in Light (on the dark bubble), text/default in Dark (on the dark grey bubble).

quote-bg.$description: The quoted message in an Agent suggestion: bg/canvas in Light, a lighter wash than bg/muted so the sender's avatar stands off it; bg/muted in Dark.

tone.$description: One mode per tone; components bind to these and pick a tone by mode (CSS: data-tone).

radius-xl.$description: Cards, menus, toasts. shadcn derivation gives 14; 12 is deliberate.

radius-3xl.$description: Rounded trays that wrap onto several lines (attachmentGroup). Extension.

radius-full.$description: Circles: avatars, dots, switch and radio marks. Never scales.

radius-pill.$description: Pill-shaped controls (shape rounded, chips, tabs). Follows the theme's corner scale: square at 0, 6px at 0.5, 12px at Satin's default 1, a full pill only at 1.5, so every step of the scale changes them.

spacing.$description: Paddings: button 0 x 10-12, card 16-20, menu inset 4.

font-normal.$description: Linear-like weights on Geist Variable: regular a touch above 400, medium 510, semibold 590.

font-medium.$description: Linear-like weights on Geist Variable: regular a touch above 400, medium 510, semibold 590.

font-semibold.$description: Linear-like weights on Geist Variable: regular a touch above 400, medium 510, semibold 590.

text-body.$description: Content scale: what people read. Fixed; 14px is the body.

text-body-lg.$description: Content scale: what people read. Fixed; 14px is the body.

text-title.$description: Content scale: what people read. Fixed; 14px is the body.

text-heading.$description: Content scale: what people read. Fixed; 14px is the body.

text-display.$description: Content scale: what people read. Fixed; 14px is the body.

tracking-tight.$description: -1.5% on every text style. Set as percent on styles, not a Figma variable (Figma number variables are px only).

2xl.$description: Empty state, hero in app. Line height 130%.

effect.$description: Colors are theme variables, so one style resolves per mode: Dark doubles the black and lights the top edge (highlight-top is transparent in Light).

shadow-primary.$description: Primary button. The 1px spread ring follows the fill: swap {theme.action.primary.bg} for primary-hover / primary-pressed per state.

shadow-destructive.$description: Destructive button: same as shadow-primary with the 1px ring in color/destructive.

shadow-border-focus.$description: Focus state for every control: 3px spread in ext/focus-ring (primary at 20%).

shadow-xs-focus.$description: shadow-xs plus the 3px focus spread (selected segment in focus).
